releases.title: One-tap navigation
changes: Open and close navigation with one touch. The original icon, button size and Menu caption are preserved.
Desktop navigation has its own gutter. Phones retain their full content width, with a soft fade behind the floating menu that continues through the top safe area.
technical: Touch release activates the disclosure once and suppresses its duplicate compatibility click. Cancelled touches and scrolling gestures do not activate navigation; keyboard and mouse behavior remain available.

The desktop shell reserves 96px for navigation at widths of 1080px and above. Mobile uses a non-interactive, theme-aware gradient from the top edge, with viewport-fit and safe-area spacing for cutouts and browser chrome.

releases.title: Readable planner headers
changes: The guided planner's Advanced link now sits with the planning text on a solid background, away from the cinematic artwork.
Context headers keep long text and controls within their reserved content area in both themes and on narrow screens.
technical: Removed the guided header's competing flex layout and constrained shared header content to its available width. Artwork remains decorative; PI behavior and saved settings are unchanged.
Added a read-only browser audit for content overlapping header artwork and horizontal overflow, with a documented theme and breakpoint verification procedure.

releases.title: Motion and a clearer menu
changes: Marketing sections now reveal more visibly as you scroll, with restrained parallax on the cinematic hero, PI story and community-direction artwork.
Find navigation more easily with a visible Menu label at the top of each page. The fixed control becomes compact during scrolling and shows Close when open.
technical: Artwork updates only while nearby, coalesces scroll events into animation frames, pauses in hidden tabs and uses a smaller travel limit on phones. Copy, controls and operation figures stay stationary.
Reduced-motion changes cancel active entrances and reset artwork offsets. Native disclosures and unhidden content remain available without JavaScript.
The Menu caption sits below the original 28px icon and 48px button. Menu dismissal, focus restoration, permissions and PI behavior are preserved.

releases.title: Orbital Command
changes: Meet AstraCore’s new Orbital Command identity: all your alts, one operation. PI is available today; help shape other operation tools through community ideas.
Explore a cinematic introduction with a dedicated mobile scene, the existing PI walkthrough, and clearer Plan → Build → Operate guidance.
See the next useful action, colony-build progress, forecasts and current operation readouts grouped on your dashboard.
Use a consistent visual system across PI planning, Operate, area selection, settings, character connection, onboarding, profile and community pages in both themes.
technical: Selected responsive WebP artwork uses the existing content-hashed static asset system. Original marketing artwork is attributed separately from official EVE item imagery.
Shared navigation retains its disclosure fallback, keyboard handling and registered-module permissions. PI calculations, field names, saved-plan behavior and ESI scopes are unchanged.
General and PI social metadata use their corresponding Orbital Command share covers.
limitations: Fittings, PvP and fleet preparation are illustrative community directions, not available modules or promised release dates.
PI forecasts still depend on yield, market prices, taxes and hauling assumptions. Existing invite and optional permission rules remain in effect.

releases.title: Help shape AstraCore
changes: Explore the roadmap and see which improvements are being considered, planned, or worked on.
Signed-in pilots can suggest ideas and report bugs, with a clear preview of what will be shared publicly.
Find the project source, contribution guide, and license directly from the platform.
Follow readable release notes, with technical details available when you choose to show them.
technical: Release metadata ships with the application and is checked against the package version before publication.
Community reports have local tracking and a GitHub issue link when publication is configured and succeeds.
The source is available under PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0; third-party material retains its own terms.
The planner dependency is restricted to supported PuLP 3 releases (3.3 or newer, below 4) to preserve compatibility with the existing optimizer.
limitations: The PI planner audit has identified market-liquidity and factory-restock improvements. Those changes are on the roadmap and are not included in this release.
A submitted idea is reviewed before it becomes a development commitment. GitHub publication depends on the operator's integration configuration.

releases.title: Existing PI platform baseline
changes: AstraCore already offered EVE sign-in, character management, PI planning, colony templates, and operation tracking before this release history was introduced.
technical: 1.0.0 was the existing package version. It is recorded here as a baseline, not as a newly reconstructed historical release. No original release date is asserted.
